purpose: Map the 75 discovered candidate asset ids (frontier v0 + advance v1/v2) to Binance USD-M perpetual contracts from a live exchangeInfo snapshot, with an explicit status per candidate. Discovery only: no historical PIT membership, listing or contract-continuity claim.

prior_artifact.note: frozen file is not modified by this artifact

source.name: Binance USD-M Futures exchangeInfo
source.note: live snapshot; fapi.binance.com returned HTTP 451 (geo-blocked) in this environment, www.binance.com/fapi/v1/exchangeInfo returned HTTP 200. The 1.15 MB raw response is not stored in-repo; only its checksum is recorded.

method.candidate_union: universe_frontier.json + universe_frontier_advance_v1.json + universe_frontier_advance_v2.json, de-duplicated by stable asset id
method.match_key: baseAsset equals candidate symbol, contractType PERPETUAL, status TRADING, quoteAsset USDT
method.multiplier_contracts: 1000SHIBUSDT and 1000PEPEUSDT matched to SHIB and PEPE (baseAsset 1000SHIB / 1000PEPE); notional_multiplier records 1000
method.quote_variants: USDT is the primary contract; USDC/USD1/BTC-quoted perpetuals are recorded in other_quote_variants and never used as the primary mapping

status_taxonomy.mapped_discovery_only_unverified: a TRADING USDT-quoted PERPETUAL exists for the base asset
status_taxonomy.no_perp_expected: stablecoin / wrapped / staked / synthetic asset class; no directional perp expected
status_taxonomy.not_listed_binance_um: tradable asset with no Binance USD-M PERPETUAL in the live snapshot (not a statement about other venues)
status_taxonomy.no_trading_perp: a PERPETUAL exists but status is not TRADING (SETTLING / PENDING_TRADING)
status_taxonomy.blocked_unknown: no match and the asset class is unclassified; requires manual review

method.pit_status: every row is discovery_only_unverified; exchangeInfo is a live snapshot and must never be used as historical point-in-time listing or membership evidence

notes: Does not modify frozen research_state/candidate_perp_mapping_v1.json or the universe frontier artifacts.
All mappings are discovery-only and rank-unverified for PIT purposes; current rank and current listing status must never be projected backward.
A live exchangeInfo snapshot cannot establish listing/delisting dates; contract-lifecycle evidence is a separate registration decision.
Assets without a Binance USD-M perpetual are preserved with an explicit status and reason; none are silently omitted.
The 75-candidate frontier is the union of the 25-candidate frontier, the v1 delta (25 entries, 2 duplicates) and the v2 delta (27 new), matching the v2 cursor of 75 distinct ids.
